description: Change a JSON file by JSON pointer (prefer this over rewriting the file). set = {pointer: new value} (any JSON value; missing object levels are created; - appends to an array); del = array of pointers to delete. Find the place with json_read first. Everything is checked first; if one pointer fails, nothing is written. Errors: FileMissing, FileBad, PointerBad, PointerMissing. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/json_write.json.

path.description: the JSON file, relative to your workspace, or absolute
